resources.string: Sprout says: unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There — you just meditated a little.

string-array.name: home_break_facts
string-array.item: A 5-minute break every hour can boost focus more than powering through.
Looking away from screens every 20 minutes eases eye strain.
Short walks after sitting boost circulation and mood.
Micro-breaks reduce mental fatigue faster than one long break.
Deep breathing for 60 seconds can lower your heart rate.
Stretching for 2 minutes releases tension built up from sitting.
Stepping outside for daylight helps reset your internal clock.
A brief pause between tasks improves memory retention.
Hydrating during breaks supports concentration afterward.
Even 90 seconds of stillness can lower stress hormones.
